references.title: Google Street View actual Hietalahdenkatu7 southwest front, August2024; number7, six glazed ribbons and ground actually opened

observations: The actual August2024 facade has SIX continuous upper glazed balcony ribbons, separated by pale grey panel spandrels and light vertical glazing bars; the first is broad/tall and the top narrower.
Dark rough grey-stone ground storey, wide shop-like glazing and a recessed entry toward the south end. This is a modern panel/glass building, not a generic classical punched-window facade.
Original twelve-module glazing divisions, reflection tones and panel seams approximate the observed long continuous ribbons without copying reflection images.
